top10.introHtml: These are the standout convertibles from this week's search — ranked on model reliability, condition, mileage, and value within a 35-mile radius of Media, PA. BMWs and Audis dominate because they offer the best combination of driving engagement and long-term durability in this price range. Note: Ford Thunderbird (2002–2005) excluded as 2-seater; MINI, Buick, Solara, Camaro, and early Mustangs (pre-2005) excluded per preferences. Lexus SC 430 and INFINITI M30 excluded (seating unconfirmed).

picks.whyGood: 39k miles on a 128i is exceptional — BMW 1-series N51/N52 inline-6 is one of the most durable engines at this price point. Selden Motors is a known local dealer. Great Deal rating.
picks.whatToVerify: DISA valve (common N51 failure, ~$200 fix). Check for rear subframe cracks. Roof hydraulic fluid level. Confirm no hidden accident on Carfax.
picks.bottomLine: Best balance of low miles and driver feel in this entire search. At $14,140 it's not the cheapest, but the miles justify the price.

picks.whyGood: 2016 Audi A3 Cabriolet is the newest car in this search with the most modern tech (MMI, push-button start). Private seller with no accidents. Springfield PA is just 4 miles away.
picks.whatToVerify: DSG transmission service history (every 40k). Timing chain tensioner tick on cold start. Confirm soft top operates fully — Audi cabriolet tops can have latch issues.
picks.bottomLine: The most modern droptop in the list. 84k miles on a private-seller Audi A3 at $12,500 with no accidents is solid value.

picks.whyGood: 2016 Audi A5 Cabriolet from Divan Auto Group in Trevose — one of the sharper-looking cars here. Good Deal rating. 111k miles is on the higher side but the A5 is known to handle miles well.
picks.whatToVerify: Oil consumption (S-tronic 2.0T can burn oil at higher miles). Timing chain condition. Roof liner sagging — common on older Audi cabriolets.
picks.bottomLine: Best-looking car in the list for the money. If the oil consumption check out, this is a winner at $11,480.

picks.whyGood: 34,866 miles on a 2001 CLK 430 is unbelievably low — someone barely drove this. The M113 V8 is bulletproof when maintained. Selden Motors in Willow Grove is a reputable dealer.
picks.whatToVerify: Age-related rubber degradation — coolant hoses, motor mounts, vacuum lines all 23+ years old. AC system (R-134a common CLK failure). Soft top condition (canvas can dry-rot from age even with low miles).
picks.bottomLine: Rare low-mileage W208 CLK. The V8 deserves attention — inspect it carefully for deferred maintenance on a car that's sat more than it's been driven.

picks.whyGood: BMW 328i (F30-chassis convertible is actually the 428i; this is the E93 328i) at $9,452 with no accidents. Good Deal rating. BMW 3-series convertibles are rare finds under $10k.
picks.whatToVerify: Timing chain guide wear (N52 E93 issue at high miles — listen for cold-start rattle). Power roof operation. Wilton/leather interior condition. Josie's Auto Sales — verify dealer reputation.
picks.bottomLine: At $9,452 this is one of the best-value BMW convertibles in the area. High miles but the E93 body is tough — just do the PPI.

picks.whyGood: 2011 Chrysler 200 from Weathers Motors — literally 1 mile from Media PA. 54k miles is genuinely low for a 2011. Fair Deal rating but the mileage-to-price ratio is hard to beat. Weathers is a well-known local dealer.
picks.whatToVerify: Convertible top operation and seals (common 200 weakness). Power window regulators. Pentastar 3.6 is reliable but check for P0128 codes (thermostat). Verify no flood history — 200 tops can leak.
picks.bottomLine: Not the most exciting car on the list but 54k miles at $10k from a local dealer you can revisit is hard to argue with.

picks.whyGood: 2015 BMW 435i xDrive convertible at $8,500 is the best deal-per-car in the list — this is a 2-series-generation 4-series with the twin-turbo N55. xDrive adds all-weather confidence. Private Seller Exchange.
picks.whatToVerify: N55 HPFP (high-pressure fuel pump) — check cold-start stumble. Rod bearing inspection highly recommended at 140k miles. xDrive transfer case fluid condition. Fair Deal per AT means the market thinks it's priced about right.
picks.bottomLine: Highest-performance car on the list at the lowest price. N55 rod bearings are the known risk — price a bearing inspection into your budget ($600-1200) before buying.

picks.whyGood: 2008 BMW 135i (N54 twin-turbo) with only 48,371 miles is a rare find. Good Deal rating. The N54 is tuner-famous but also well-understood — any BMW shop can work on it.
picks.whatToVerify: N54 HPFP replacement history (critical — known failure). Wastegate rattle at cold start. Walnut blast intake (carbon buildup every ~80k). Injector seals. At 48k miles these may all be first-time services.
picks.bottomLine: The enthusiast pick of the list. 48k miles on an N54 at $12,990 is solid — just verify the HPFP and wallet accordingly for turbocharged BMW maintenance.

picks.whyGood: 2004 Mercedes-Benz CLK 500 at $7,900 with 82k miles and no accidents is the best value proposition in the list. The M113 V8 is as simple and durable as large V8s get. Great Deal rating.
picks.whatToVerify: Airmatic suspension (if equipped) — sensor/compressor failures common. Age-related gaskets (21 years old). Soft top hydraulic system — cylinders can weep at this age. Waterford Works NJ is 32 miles out.
picks.bottomLine: The V8 bargain of the group. At $7,900 it's under budget with room for maintenance. The age requires diligence but the M113 reward is real.

picks.whyGood: 2014 BMW 428i from Faulkner Honda of Doylestown — reputable dealer. The F33 428i is the modern, stiffer chassis versus the older E93. Good Deal rating.
picks.whatToVerify: 153k miles is high — N20 timing chain stretch is a known issue (listen for cold-start rattle). Water pump (electric, common failure ~100k). Convertible roof seals and drains.
picks.bottomLine: The freshest-platform BMW convertible on the list at the lowest entry price after the 435i. High miles require due diligence on the N20 chain but the F33 body is worth it.

manual10.introHtml: Manual-transmission convertibles in this search area and price range. No confirmed manual listings were found this week — most sources in this region list automatics only. Check back next refresh or consider widening the radius.

mustangs.introHtml: Ford Mustang convertibles from 2005 onward, ranked by trim level then year. Found 2 this week. The 2020 EcoBoost Premium is the top pick — clean title, no accidents, 132k miles, and a Great Deal rating.

picks.whyGood: 2020 Ford Mustang Convertible — EcoBoost Premium Convertible. Great Deal.
picks.whatToVerify: Convertible top condition and operation. Check for typical Mustang rust on the rear frame rails.

picks.whyGood: 2014 Ford Mustang Convertible — V6 Convertible. Fair Deal.
picks.whatToVerify: Convertible top condition and operation. Check for typical Mustang rust on the rear frame rails.
